requirement: No federal rent-ceiling statute was found in the housing chapter of the U.S. Code (42 U.S.C. ch. 45).
meaning_here: Nothing in federal law authorises a higher increase than San Francisco allows. The federal rule that does reach an increase decision is the Fair Housing Act.

requirement: Fair Housing Act, 42 U.S.C. 3604(b): no discrimination in the terms or conditions of a rental.
meaning_here: A rent increase applied on a protected basis is unlawful even where the dollar amount is otherwise allowed. The increase terms must be set on lawful, documented grounds.

requirement: Federal antitrust enforcement over algorithmic rent-setting (DOJ v. RealPage).
meaning_here: Do not use revenue-management or algorithmic pricing tools to set or raise rent on these units; San Francisco separately bans them (see local rows).

requirement: Housing-subsidy rules (HUD / Housing Choice Voucher) - applicability not established.
meaning_here: If either unit is voucher-assisted, the rent-increase rules differ. This has NOT been verified; flagged F7.

requirement: Civil Code 827: written notice of a rent increase.
meaning_here: 30 days' notice if the increase is 10% or less; 90 days if more than 10% (alone or combined with other increases in the prior 12 months). Add 5 days if served by mail.

requirement: Civil Code 1947.12 (AB 1482): statewide cap of 5% + CPI, max 10%.
meaning_here: Does NOT set the ceiling here: subdivision (d)(3) exempts housing covered by a local ordinance that restricts increases to a lower amount. The state cap would be 8.8% for increases starting 8/1/2026-7/31/2027 - far above the local 1.6%.

requirement: Civil Code 1954.52 (Costa-Hawkins): vacancy decontrol.
meaning_here: The owner may set a new initial rent only when no tenant from the prior tenancy remains. Because an original Unit A tenant remained on 2026-04-01, that renewal was not a vacancy and did not reset the rent.

requirement: Civil Code 1942.5: no retaliatory rent increase.
meaning_here: No increase may be imposed in retaliation for repair complaints, habitability complaints or tenant organising (180-day presumption period).

requirement: Government Code 12955: state housing discrimination law.
meaning_here: Rent terms may not differ on the basis of a protected characteristic, including source of income and familial status.

requirement: Admin. Code 37.3(a)(1): annual increase = 60% of the prior year's CPI change, capped at 7%.
meaning_here: The Rent Board published 1.6% for 3/1/2026-2/28/2027 and 1.4% for 3/1/2025-2/28/2026. That is the lawful annual ceiling on base rent.

requirement: Coverage: units built on or before 13 June 1979 in a multi-unit building.
meaning_here: Both units are stated to be in a 1940 building, so both are inside the Ordinance (verification of the property record is flagged F6).

requirement: One increase every 12 months; anniversary date.
meaning_here: The first increase may be imposed 12 months after the lease began; after that, at least 12 months apart. An increase imposed later sets a new anniversary date.

requirement: Banking: an unused increase may be taken later.
meaning_here: A skipped increase is banked only if at least 24 full months pass without any rent increase; banked percentages are added, never compounded, and may not be rounded up. There is no cap and banked amounts do not expire during the tenancy.

requirement: Rent increase license / Housing Inventory.
meaning_here: The unit must be reported to the Rent Board Housing Inventory (deadline March 1 each year) and a current rent increase license must exist on the effective date, or the notice is unenforceable.

requirement: Increase is calculated on base rent only.
meaning_here: Apply the percentage to base rent (including parking/storage if part of base rent); exclude temporary passthroughs and fluctuating charges. Do not round up to the nearest dollar.

requirement: Notice content: annual portion, banked portion and the dates it is based on.
meaning_here: The notice must state the dollar amount, the percentage, the effective date, which part is banked and the dates of the banked years (Rule 4.10 / 37.3(b)).

requirement: No increase solely because an additional occupant moved in.
meaning_here: The 2026-04-01 addition of a co-tenant to Unit A cannot support any extra rent, even if a lease clause says otherwise.

requirement: Tenant challenge: petition for unlawful rent increase, no fee, no time limit.
meaning_here: Any increase can be reviewed by a Rent Board Administrative Law Judge; a defective increase can be reduced or voided. Build the file accordingly.

requirement: Tenant legal help.
meaning_here: Tenants have access to free Rent Board counseling and, in eviction proceedings, the City-funded Tenant Right to Counsel Program (Eviction Defense Collaborative intake).

requirement: Section 37.10C: algorithmic rent-setting devices banned.
meaning_here: No pricing software may be used to set these rents; a tenant or the City Attorney may sue.

requirement: Pending: File 261020, 10% cap on combined banked + capital-improvement increases.
meaning_here: Introduced 2026-09-15, status '30 Day Rule' - not law as of 2026-11-06. Any banked plan must be re-checked before notice is served.
